searched: Searched on 2026-10-15 for Meta (FAIR, the 2023 generative AI product group, Meta Superintelligence Labs, Meta Compute) and xAI (launch team, co-founder departures, SpaceX combination and renaming), 2013–2026. Discovery used web search and reporting pages only to locate posts; evidence was retrieved with tools.mjs. Retrieved primary sources: Scale AI's 12 June 2025 announcement; Meta's FAIR ten-year retrospective (ai.meta.com, already a dataset source) and Meta Brazil's December 2024 Llama post; Mark Zuckerberg's Threads posts of 25 July 2025 and 12 January 2026; X posts by Alexandr Wang, Shengjia Zhao, Nat Friedman, Ahmad Al-Dahle, Greg Yang, Yuhuai (Tony) Wu, Jimmy Ba, Toby Pohlen, Guodong Zhang, Elon Musk and the xAI/SpaceXAI account; the AMI Labs homepage. Reporting was used where no primary text could be retrieved: CNBC (Zuckerberg's 30 June 2025 MSL memo as published by CNBC; Pineau's and LeCun's departures; the August 2025 four-team structure, itself citing the WSJ), Fortune/Bloomberg (Meta's February 2023 generative AI group), AP via Ada Derana (LeCun), TechCrunch (AMI leadership; Meta Compute; Kosic and Szegedy), Business Insider (Kroiss, Nordeen, Dai and the co-founder list), Mobile World Live (Fergus) and Ars Technica (the July 2023 xAI roster, already a dataset source). Retrieval failures: the Axios February 2023 article and r.jina.ai relay (CAPTCHA, then a temporary 401); about.fb.com's English Llama post (404); The Information's Szegedy briefing (paywall); LinkedIn posts by LeCun, Pineau and Fergus are not admissible through the checker and were read only as quoted by reporting; Zuckerberg's February 2023 Instagram/Facebook post, the full Threads text of the Meta Compute post beyond its first paragraphs, Linda Yaccarino's July 2025 post, Christian Szegedy's own departure post and any AMI Labs press release were not found. The Internet Archive was not used.
